description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_Lexer`, which is an abstract base class responsible for lexing HTML markup into tokens. It includes methods for creating lexer instances, parsing data, skipping CDATA sections, normalizing HTML, and extracting the body content. The class is part of the HTMLPurifier library and is intended for internal use, providing utility functions to subclasses.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for lexing HTML markup into tokens. It manages entity parsing, supports different lexer implementations, and offers utilities for processing HTML such as normalizing content, handling CDATA sections, and extracting the body.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the default lexer instance based on the configuration, supporting different implementations such as DOMLex or DirectLex.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the lexer, setting up the entity parser.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Converts HTML entities in a string to their corresponding characters.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method intended to tokenize an HTML string into tokens; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Escapes CDATA sections within HTML content by converting them into safe, escaped characters.

methods.name: escapeCommentedCDATA
methods.description: Escapes CDATA sections that are nested within comments for special handling.

methods.name: CDATACallback
methods.description: Callback used during CDATA escaping to convert CDATA content into HTML special characters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes HTML content by converting newlines, escaping CDATA, extracting body content, and expanding entities.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts the content within the `<body>` tag of an HTML document; returns original if no `<body>` found.
